text: Good evening, I do apologise for troubling you at this hour. I am looking after my grandson Thomas, who is 11, while his parents are away for the night. He has come down with a fever and I've just taken it and it reads 39.6. I checked his skin all over as my daughter told me to and there isn't any rash at all, and I did the glass test on a couple of freckly marks on his back anyway just to be sure and they went pale and faded straight away, so I don't think there's anything there to worry about on that front. My question really is about the medicine. I have both paracetamol and ibuprofen in the cupboard, the children's versions, and I am not certain how much to give a boy of his age, or whether I can give both of them or one after the other. The packets have different amounts for different ages and my eyesight isn't what it was and I don't want to give him too much. He's about average size for 11 I would say. Again I'm sorry to take up your time, I expect you have far more serious calls than mine.
